name: Feedback Ecology Map
purpose: Apply the Normalization Process Theory lens (May & Finch 2009) to how a new routine embeds: map the user's position on the four generative mechanisms (Coherence, Cognitive Participation, Collective Action, Reflexive Monitoring), assess embedding-work, and form Context-Mechanism-Outcome hypotheses for calibration. The user defines meaning; the agent asks, never supplies (T2R row 64). CMO hypotheses are hypotheses, never verdicts (Valens P4/P10).

governance.rule: The user defines meaning — the agent asks, never supplies. CMO hypotheses are hypotheses (evidence-ladder claim level), never verdicts. No embedding-work assessment is used to push the user toward a routine they have not chosen.
